objects.taxonomy_description: Domestic swine measuring 90-180 cm body length weighing 50-350 kg. Body stocky and barrel-shaped with sparse coarse bristles over pink, black, or spotted skin. Head large with elongated snout ending in cartilaginous disk for rooting. Eyes small. Ears large and floppy or erect depending on breed. Legs short and stout with cloven hooves. Tail short and curly. objects.taxonomy_description: Light-duty motor vehicle with an enclosed cab for passengers and an open cargo bed at the rear. Cab configuration includes single-row (regular cab), extended cab, or crew cab with four doors. Cargo bed features low side walls (50-60 cm high), a flat floor, and a hinged tailgate at the rear. Bed length ranges from 1.5 to 2.5 meters. Exterior constructed from painted steel or aluminum panels. Wheel arches protrude above the bed sides. Front end features a prominent grille, headlights, and bumper. Ground clearance is elevated (20-30 cm) compared to passenger cars. Overall length 5.0-6.5 meters. Distinguishing features include open rear cargo bed, tailgate mechanism, cab-to-bed transition, and utilitarian truck proportions.

Elevated ground clearance noticeably higher than passenger cars.
